data.text:
I agree to catch 12 tons this month and 8 tons if next month starts at 80. At 100, I support returning to 12 each, subject to everyone renewing the agreement after reviewing catches.

One clarification: replenishment itself is never guaranteed, but leaving 50 tons does guarantee a full stock next month under either outcome. Our proposed plan instead leaves 40, so we’re accepting that tradeoff for higher catches now—not claiming we’ve proved it maximizes long-run income.

Emma and Luke, do you also agree to the 8-ton fallback? That would give all five of us the same understanding before we choose.
